title: Anti-Pattern: Infinite Retry Loops in API Polling

bad: useEffect(() => { const interval = setInterval(async () => { await fetch('/api/data'); }, 1000); return () => clearInterval(interval); }, []);
good: const { data, isStuck, cancel } = useRetryableFetch('/api/data', {}, { maxRetries: 5, showWarningAfter: 3 });

checklist: Use useRetryableFetch hook instead of manual fetch + setInterval
